description: Profile a page and export the results in a specified format. Supported formats: 'speedscope' (JSON for speedscope.app visualization), 'csv' (spreadsheet-friendly), 'markdown' (shareable report with tables, recommendations, and severity badges). Can save to a file or return inline.

outputPath.description: Optional file path to save the export. If omitted, returns content inline.

pagePath.description: The page path to profile (defaults to '/')

name: export_profile
